verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a framework for real-time voice and multimodal agents that react to live user sessions and carrier webhooks. Nothing in the evidence documents user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled or recurring jobs or unattended triggers. Mentions of subagents for long-running tools and multi-agent coordination are developer building blocks inside a conversation pipeline, not a background-automation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
